dashboard_order_mirror.grain: One mirrored marketplace order item. One order can have multiple rows; order_net_revenue and release amounts may repeat across rows.
dashboard_order_mirror.date_basis: order_create_time and timestamp_utc are UTC order timestamps; order_create_date is the stored business day. mirrored_at is a dashboard write time and source_updated_at is source-record update time, neither proves successful complete ingestion.
dashboard_order_mirror.source_verified: Reviewed application DDL and readers; live source availability and field coverage checked on query.
dashboard_order_mirror.purpose: Stored marketplace order-item mirror with safe product, quantity, financial, release and source metadata. Use canonical sales_orders or sales_lines for status-filtered sales reporting.
warnings: Physical rows include canceled, deleted and unmapped lines unless explicitly filtered.
Do not sum repeated order_net_revenue, funds_released_amount or other order-level amounts across item rows; use canonical order aggregation.
Seller revenue, gross profit, money released and cash availability are different measures.
Match records by platform, account_key and order_id; SKU text alone is not a unique order or cross-channel deduplication key.
Product labels and cogs_quantity supplement SKU reconciliation; raw marketplace payloads and customer identifiers remain excluded.
A recent mirrored_at or source_updated_at cannot establish that every account, date or upstream order was synchronized.

ad_view_campaigns.grain: One optional local override per account_key and campaign_id.
ad_view_campaigns.date_basis: Legacy created/inserted timestamps use database CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; later explicit updates use UTC_TIMESTAMP. Because the database session timezone for initial values is unverified, automatic day conversion is disabled.
ad_view_campaigns.source_verified: Reviewed application DDL and readers; live source availability and field coverage checked on query.
ad_view_campaigns.purpose: Local campaign aliases, tracked flags and unit COGS overrides; this is not the upstream campaign inventory or daily performance dataset.
warnings: Zero local settings rows do not mean there were no campaigns, spend, impressions, clicks or attributed sales.
unit_cogs_override is a configured cost per attributed item for ad-view economics, not incurred ad spend.
Saved tracking state does not establish upstream campaign live/paused/ended status.

ad_view_budgets.grain: One optional saved budget per account and budget_month.
ad_view_budgets.date_basis: Legacy created/inserted timestamps use database CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; later explicit updates use UTC_TIMESTAMP. Because the database session timezone for initial values is unverified, automatic day conversion is disabled.
ad_view_budgets.source_verified: Reviewed application DDL and readers; live source availability and field coverage checked on query.
ad_view_budgets.purpose: Local planned monthly ad budgets, not consumed ad spend or wallet funding.
warnings: Empty local configuration or annotations do not mean there were no ads, ad spend or upstream activity.
Read stored all-status campaign performance through jg_ads_history and keep daily and hourly overlapping totals separate.

ad_view_credit_alerts.date_basis: Legacy created/inserted timestamps use database CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; later explicit updates use UTC_TIMESTAMP. Because the database session timezone for initial values is unverified, automatic day conversion is disabled.
ad_view_credit_alerts.source_verified: Reviewed application DDL and readers; live source availability and field coverage checked on query.
ad_view_credit_alerts.purpose: Local credit-alert thresholds, not actual current credit balances.
warnings: Empty local configuration or annotations do not mean there were no ads, ad spend or upstream activity.
Read stored all-status campaign performance through jg_ads_history and keep daily and hourly overlapping totals separate.

ad_view_events.grain: One local event annotation; event_at is a user-entered operational event time.
ad_view_events.date_basis: event_at is entered and stored as Asia/Jakarta wall time without UTC conversion. created_at uses database CURRENT_TIMESTAMP with unverified session timezone. Do not add seven hours to event_at.
ad_view_events.source_verified: Reviewed application DDL and readers; live source availability and field coverage checked on query.
ad_view_events.purpose: Local ad-change annotations with before/after values, not daily campaign performance.
warnings: Empty local configuration or annotations do not mean there were no ads, ad spend or upstream activity.
Read stored all-status campaign performance through jg_ads_history and keep daily and hourly overlapping totals separate.

executive_chart_context.grain: One historical day or month identified by period_key. Only configured supported historical periods can be edited by the app.
executive_chart_context.date_basis: period_key is the historical reporting period; updated_at UTC is when the manual context was last edited or seeded, not the sales coverage cutoff.
executive_chart_context.source_verified: Reviewed application DDL and readers; live source availability and field coverage checked on query.
executive_chart_context.purpose: Saved historical Executive chart context and corrections. These records supplement or replace historical sales summary values through the canonical context implementation; they are not current monthly P&L or sync checkpoints.
warnings: An old updated_at is expected for unchanged historical context; do not label marketplace sync stale from this timestamp alone.
The app permits monthly periods in 2025 and January-April 2026, and daily periods May 1-19 2026. This is not a complete monthly sales table.
Canonical jg_executive_context_apply_summary replaces monthly context and adds daily context after configured live-overlap corrections; summing context with raw sales can double count.
gross_profit in this historical context is not current computed monthly net profit or a named-recipient allocation.

dashboard_order_location_cache.grain: One cached aggregate metadata record per requested range and geocoder version; ranges may overlap.
dashboard_order_location_cache.purpose: Read-only cache coverage and generation metadata for the dashboard order-location report. Excludes all raw addresses and aggregate payloads.
dashboard_order_location_cache.date_basis: start_date/end_date are requested reporting dates; mirror_last_mirrored_at and generated_at are UTC timestamps.
dashboard_order_location_cache.source_verified: Reviewed jg_orders_ensure_location_cache_schema and cache validity checks in api/orders/index.php; live availability checked on query.
warnings: Cached range counts overlap and must not be summed across cached requests.
Cache records do not have an account dimension; they represent the configured dashboard aggregate, not a per-account slice.
Current cache validity requires matching mirror row count, distinct order count and latest mirrored timestamp for the range; generated_at alone is insufficient.
No refresh, geocoder call or cache write is triggered by this reader. Missing cache is unavailable evidence, not proof of zero orders.

store_ops_walkin_invoices.source_verified: Reviewed pinned Store Ops source DDL and dashboard consumer; live table and column availability must be checked on query.
store_ops_walkin_invoices.date_basis: created_at is stored UTC by jg_store_ops_walkins_now; displayed business date is Asia/Jakarta.
store_ops_walkin_invoices.grain: One stored Store Ops invoice, including walk_in and whatsapp print records.
store_ops_walkin_invoices.purpose: Safe counter invoice financial and type facts without buyer, operator, receipt or payment-reference details.
warnings: Filter invoice_type=walk_in to match canonical independent counter sales. WhatsApp printed copies may duplicate dashboard direct orders; do not add them as another sale.
subtotal minus discount_total is merchandise consideration; total also includes tax/shipping. Neither is net profit.
analytics_visible is a stored visibility flag. Canonical downstream reports apply their own recognition filters; physical invoice rows are not an audited cash or revenue total.

store_ops_walkin_invoice_items.source_verified: Reviewed pinned Store Ops source DDL and dashboard consumer; live table and column availability must be checked on query.
store_ops_walkin_invoice_items.date_basis: created_at is stored UTC by jg_store_ops_walkins_now; displayed business date is Asia/Jakarta.
store_ops_walkin_invoice_items.grain: One stored invoice item; invoice_number joins to store_ops_walkin_invoices.invoice_number.
store_ops_walkin_invoice_items.purpose: Counter and printed direct-order item quantities, prices and discounts with safe SKU/product identity.
warnings: Parent invoice_type must be checked before counting independent walk-in sales; WhatsApp print rows may duplicate dashboard direct sales.
Line totals and parent invoice totals are different grains; never sum both. Quantity/price/discount records are not sold-product COGS or net profit.
Stored scan flags are operational observations, not proof of present stock availability.

zero_store_voucher.grain: One saved ZERO storefront voucher-rule record. Voucher identity/secret/hint is excluded.
zero_store_voucher.purpose: Safe configured discount percentage, validity window, stacking behavior and enabled state.
zero_store_voucher.source_verified: Reviewed zero-voucher-bootstrap.php DDL and save normalization; live availability checked on query.
zero_store_voucher.date_basis: All datetime fields are UTC; the app converts entered Asia/Jakarta validity dates before storage.
warnings: Configured rules are not voucher redemptions, actual discounts granted or lost revenue.
is_enabled alone does not establish current applicability; the validity window and pricing/stacking rules also apply.
Voucher code, code_hash and code_hint are deliberately excluded. No code validation or redemption is performed.
